title: ingested_at_ms in articles table must use SystemTime::now(), not article Date header
description: transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs:231-234: the comment 'ingested_at_ms MUST be the current wall-clock time (SystemTime::now()), NOT from the article's Date header or ctx.timestamp — those are peer-supplied' is load-bearing documentation for the GC system. The GC grace period protects newly ingested articles from immediate collection. If ingested_at_ms were set from the article's Date header (which can be arbitrary — old articles, backdated articles, articles with future dates), the grace period would be meaningless: an article dated 2020 ingested today would show age_days = 1500 and be immediately eligible for GC. The current design is correct. A contributor who 'cleans up' this comment because it seems obvious will remove the only documentation protecting this invariant.
